title: althaea kurdica var. schirazana
intro: Althaea kurdica var. schirazana, commonly known as the Schirazi marshmallow, is a plant species within the mallow family (Malvaceae) native to Iran. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Althaea kurdica var. schirazana include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include mucilages, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
